name: lumen3d
description: Lumen3D: 3D Exterior Reconstruction & Holiday Lighting Studio

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@lumen3d/shared-schemas && npm run build --workspace=@lumen3d/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@lumen3d/shared-schemas && npm run typecheck --workspace=@lumen3d/shared-schemas && npm run typecheck --workspace=@lumen3d/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n worker,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web:https"
